dashboard_title: Student Retention and Exit Analysis Dashboard
purpose: Monitor student retention, exit rates, and academic performance across faculties and majors.
audience: Academic administrators and student affairs staff

kpis.name: Average GPA of Exiting Students
kpis.metric: เกรดเฉลี่ย_GPAX
source_fields: เกรดเฉลี่ย_GPAX

kpis.name: Exit Rate by Faculty
kpis.formula: COUNT(*) WHERE status = 'ลาออก' GROUP BY คณะ
kpis.limitations: Excludes students with missing faculty or status

kpis.name: Exit Rate by Exit Reason
kpis.formula: COUNT(*) WHERE status = 'ลาออก' GROUP BY สาเหตุการลาออก
source_fields: สาเหตุการลาออก
kpis.limitations: Excludes students with missing exit reason or status

kpis.name: Average GPA by Faculty
kpis.metric: เกรดเฉลี่ย_GPAX
source_fields: เกรดเฉลี่ย_GPAX
kpis.limitations: Excludes students with missing faculty or GPA

charts.title: Exit Rate by Faculty and Year
charts.formula: COUNT(*) WHERE status = 'ลาออก' GROUP BY คณะ, _year_be
source_fields: วันที่ลาออก
charts.limitations: Excludes students with missing faculty, status, or date of exit

charts.title: Exit Rate by Exit Reason
charts.dimension: สาเหตุการลาออก
charts.formula: COUNT(*) WHERE status = 'ลาออก' GROUP BY สาเหตุการลาออก
source_fields: สาเหตุการลาออก
charts.limitations: Excludes students with missing exit reason or status

charts.title: Average GPA of Exiting Students Over Time
charts.metric: เกรดเฉลี่ย_GPAX
charts.formula: AVG(gpa) WHERE status = 'ลาออก' GROUP BY _year_be
source_fields: เกรดเฉลี่ย_GPAX
วันที่ลาออก
charts.limitations: Excludes students with missing GPA, status, or date of exit

charts.title: Student Exit Trends by Month
charts.formula: COUNT(*) WHERE status = 'ลาออก' GROUP BY _month_th
source_fields: วันที่ลาออก
charts.limitations: Excludes students with missing status or date of exit

insight_questions: What is the trend in student exits over time?
Which faculty has the highest exit rate?
What are the primary reasons for student exits?
